prerequisites: No specific prerequisites. Prior knowledge depending on the specific focus of the seminar is recommended, generally knowledge from basic modules in Computer Science and Mathematics.

learning_outcomes.text: The students are able to independently learn a specialized topic in computer science.
The students are able to process, divide, and supplement contexts in computer science with explanatory content.
The students are able to handle and search for scientific literature.
The students are able to give a structured presentation tailored to the audience's competencies.
The students are able to use presentation media.
The students are able to discuss content from computer science in a structured manner within a group.

syllabus_topics: Topics from the field of computer science. The specific professional orientation of the seminar is determined by the lecturer.
assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. The seminar presentation accounts for 1 ECTS point and the written elaboration accounts for 2 ECTS points.
bibliography: Depending on the thematic focus of the seminar
